text:
Amy (People Ops): Thanks for joining the all-hands Q&A — quick follow-up thread for any remaining questions about reviews, leveling, promotions, comp and benefits.
Kai (CEO): appreciate everyone who asked tough questions earlier. we'll share the recording + slides in a sec :white_check_mark:
allhands-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood-inference.zoom/rec/abcd1234
Jordan (SWE): Quick question on calibration: if I disagree with my manager's rating, what's the right next step? is there an appeals window?
Amy (People Ops): Short answer: yes. talk to your manager first, then ping me or people-ops-priv for calibration follow-up. we have a 2-week window after reviews for formal disputes.
Priya (SWE): Are promotions still aligned to the review cycle or can managers submit off-cycle promotion packets?
Ravi (VP Eng): We prefer aligning to cycle for transparency, but off-cycle promos are possible for exceptional cases. managers should consult with ppl-ops + eng-ops before moving forward.
Liam (Engineering Manager): For leveling guidance, is there an updated rubric? the old doc mixes expectations across IC/manager paths.
Amy (People Ops): New leveling rubrics are posted under Handbook > Career Ladders. link in #docs coming now. we added clearer IC vs manager examples.
Maya (Finance): On comp: FYI we expect merit budgets to be slightly higher this cycle due to market adjustments; exact $% will be shared with managers by next monday.
Jordan (SWE): thanks — any clarity on when offers/promotions get effective for payroll? end of month or next pay period?
Amy (People Ops): Effective dates are typically the 1st of the month after approval. exceptions exist for urgent business needs.
Priya (SWE): Equity refreshes — are those part of the review conversations or a separate cadence?
Ravi (VP Eng): Usually separate. managers can recommend refreshes during review packets, but comp committee approves based on role, tenure, and market.
Jordan (SWE): Is salary transparency changing? earlier townhall comment sounded like more openness on bands.
Kai (CEO): We're moving toward clearer band ranges visible to the company (band min/mid/max). exact timing depends on legal/benchmarks; update in 2 weeks.
Liam (Engineering Manager): For managers: any training on giving promotion feedback and writing packets? would like a short workshop.
Amy (People Ops): Yep — planning a 60-min training next thursday at 10am. calendar invite to managers and IC mentors.
Priya (SWE): Benefits: will parental leave policy be extended as discussed? my partner is expecting in june.
Maya (Finance): Confirmed — parental leave extension approved by execs. details and eligibility on the benefits page; ppl-ops will follow up with 1:1 options.
Jordan (SWE): Thanks everyone. adding one more: is there a checklist for managers to drive equitable calibration?
Amy (People Ops): Yes — checklist + sample packet template are in the handbook. I'll paste links in #docs and DM managers the template.
Kai (CEO): Thanks Amy and Maya. please keep questions coming here so we can close any gaps from the all-hands.
Liam (Engineering Manager): +1 — appreciate the quick followups.
Amy (People Ops): Closing note — if you want anonymous feedback, use the form: https://forms.redwood/allhands-peopleops-qa
